about.metaTitle: About Menuyukti — Build Your Restaurant Stack
about.metaDescription: Menuyukti is a modular restaurant platform that connects operations, interactive loyalty, and business intelligence—so you can run your restaurant, engage guests, and grow smarter.
about.title: Build Your Restaurant Stack.
about.intro: Every restaurant operates differently. Menuyukti brings essential restaurant operations, customer engagement, and business intelligence together in one modular platform — giving you the flexibility to choose the tools your business needs.
about.tagline: Engage Customers. Build Loyalty. Grow Smarter.

pillars.title: Run your restaurant.
pillars.description: Manage orders, payments, inventory, and staff from one connected foundation.

pillars.title: Engage your guests.
pillars.description: Turn visits into interactive experiences with digital menus and participation-based loyalty.

pillars.title: Understand your business.
pillars.description: Use sales reporting, heatmaps, participation analytics, and conversational AI to decide with clearer context.

about.platformBody: From managing orders and inventory to understanding sales performance, Menuyukti helps restaurant owners manage everyday operations through connected tools.
about.platformBodyFollow: Shared information reduces unnecessary duplication and creates a foundation for additional services, including interactive digital menus and customer loyalty.
about.loyaltyIntro: Traditional loyalty programs usually reward purchases. Menuyukti takes engagement further by allowing guests to earn loyalty points through participation.
about.loyaltyIntroFollow: After scanning a QR code, guests can explore the restaurant's digital experience, participate in interactive activities, and earn rewards along the way.
about.loyaltyPickAndWinExample: Predict tonight's football match winner and earn points for participating, with bonus points for a correct prediction.
about.loyaltyVotingBody: Guests participate in decisions and share preferences.
loyaltyVotingExamples: Vote for the next matcha special.
Help decide which seasonal product should be introduced.
about.loyaltyModulesEmphasis: Two reusable interaction modules. Countless possible experiences.
loyaltyValueItems: Create engaging experiences during restaurant visits.
View participation statistics and voting results.
Build customer relationships beyond individual transactions.
about.insightsTitle: Understand What Your Guests Really Like.
about.insightsBody: Every interaction can tell a story.
about.insightsBodyFollow: When guests vote on upcoming menu items or participate in interactive activities, restaurants gain valuable information about customer preferences.
about.insightsBodyClose: Menuyukti connects these interactions with participation analytics, helping restaurant owners make more informed decisions about their offerings and customer experiences.
insightsSteps: Restaurants view participation and voting results.
Restaurants use these insights to inform decisions.
about.intelligenceTitle: Smarter Decisions Start With Better Insights.
about.intelligenceBody: Running a restaurant means making decisions every day.
about.intelligenceBodyFollow: Menuyukti combines advanced sales reporting, time-based sales heatmaps, and conversational AI assistance to make restaurant technology more accessible and useful.

intelligenceItems.name: Advanced Sales Reporting
intelligenceItems.description: Explore sales performance through detailed reports.

intelligenceItems.name: Sales Heatmaps
intelligenceItems.description: Visualize sales activity across different times and days to identify operational patterns.

intelligenceItems.name: Conversational AI Assistant
intelligenceItems.description: Access intelligent assistance through a conversational interface.

about.modularBody: Restaurants have different needs, and those needs change over time.
about.modularBodyFollow: Menuyukti is designed around modular services, allowing businesses to extend their platform with additional functionality when it makes sense for them.
about.modularBodyClose: From digital menus to interactive loyalty, restaurants can choose the capabilities that support their operations and customer relationships.
about.modularPricingNote: POS + Inventory is the free core. Additional services can be added as needed on a monthly basis.
about.whyTitle: Built to Make Restaurant Technology More Accessible.
about.whyBody: Restaurant technology should help businesses operate more efficiently and build stronger relationships with their customers — without unnecessary complexity.
about.whyBodyFollow: Menuyukti brings together practical restaurant management, thoughtful user experience, intelligent assistance, and interactive customer engagement.
about.whyBodyClose: The vision is simple: make advanced restaurant technology more accessible, flexible, and useful for businesses of different sizes.
about.ctaTitle: Discover What Menuyukti Can Do for Your Restaurant.
about.ctaBody: Explore the platform, discover interactive customer experiences, and help shape the future of Menuyukti.
about.distinction: Menuyukti is not merely a digital menu, a traditional loyalty program, or a POS system. It connects restaurant operations with customer engagement and business intelligence through one modular platform.
